$comment: The one token file of Instrument, the cmux design system (cmuxterm-hq docs/rfd/0034-design-instrument.md, 'Adopted 2026-11-22', its token table between instrument-tokens:begin/end). Each token has the value Instrument names (`instrument`) and the value the app draws today (`today`), read from the source that sets it now. Where the two differ the Instrument value is recorded, not applied: the generated CSS (webviews/src/ui/instrument.generated.css) carries today's value, so this file moves no pixel. A default moves when its own source moves; scripts/cmux-next/gen-instrument-tokens.py --check then fails until `today` here says the new value, and the pending list (pending-baseline.json) may only shrink. CHANGELOG.md beside this file records every version.

questions.leo-1: Two tones on by default, or one colour by default with two tones as the first toggle.
questions.leo-2: The corner rule's values where they move a drawn radius (card 12, composer 16, popup 12, toast 12).
questions.leo-3: The prose column (800 px today) down to 560 to 720 px, and tool rows at 13/20.
questions.skin: A skin value outside the four questions; the debate record says the skin's defaults wait on Leo.
questions.skeleton: A settled skeleton value the app does not draw yet; moving it is a default change in its own PR, with before and after captures.
questions.no-token: Nothing in the app carries this value yet: a missing token (RFD section 9).

tokens.name: seed.grid
tokens.drawnOn: every length: gaps, insets, heights and corners are multiples of it

tokens.name: seed.control-height
tokens.drawnOn: button, field, menu row, sidebar row

tokens.name: seed.text
tokens.drawnOn: chrome text: rows, tabs, menus, buttons, Settings labels

tokens.name: corner.rule
tokens.rule: min(control corner + inset, floor4(shortest height / 3)); outer = inner + gap

tokens.name: corner.control
tokens.drawnOn: button, field, menu row, sidebar row, tab

tokens.name: corner.chip
tokens.drawnOn: chip, inline code, 20 px icon button

tokens.name: corner.tooltip
tokens.drawnOn: tooltip (surface-roles: a null webRadius is the popup radius)

tokens.name: corner.card
tokens.drawnOn: surfaces that read --ds-radius-card: the inbox notice card (conversation/InboxNoticeCard.css:64), the Settings wallpaper editor (pages/settings/styles.css:1697), the feature tip (ui/featureTip.gallery.css:20); pageDensity.css:38 scales it
tokens.note: The transcript's cards do not read this scale: each draws its own raw corner (offToken). The captures measured the transcript permission card at 8 inside 8; the code's default for the ask is the layout grid's 12 (--grid-cards-radius) and 6 inside the permission panel.

offToken.on: permission card inside the permission panel
agent message card, card and corner looks

tokens.name: corner.composer
tokens.drawnOn: surfaces that read --ds-radius-composer: the composer drop overlay (composer/dropOverlay.css:29,44); pageDensity.css:39 scales it
tokens.note: Three sources disagree, which is part of leo-2: design-scale.json says 18 and notes that grid.md moves card and composer to 12 after a gallery comparison; layout-grid.json's composer-radius is already 12 and is what the composer draws (data-composer-grid is always set, Composer.tsx:2830); Instrument says 16. The composer box itself does not read --ds-radius-composer (offToken).

offToken.on: composer box and asks stack without data-composer-grid
strip and queue over the box

tokens.name: corner.capsule
tokens.rule: never: no box has a corner of half its height

tokens.name: ink.step
tokens.rule: 4%: every fill and line is a multiple of it

tokens.name: ink.frame
tokens.drawnOn: sidebar, tab bar, title bar, docks; card fill

tokens.name: ink.hover
tokens.drawnOn: hovered row, tab and control; prompt bubble fill

tokens.name: ink.selected
tokens.note: The selection role is its own value (design-scale colors selection, 10% ink). The transcript's selected row draws its own fill instead (offToken); the mock draws 6%.

tokens.name: ink.text
tokens.drawnOn: body text, links, primary button, focus ring

tokens.name: ink.text-muted
tokens.instrument: 84% light, 80% dark, as a solid mix

tokens.name: ink.text-dim
tokens.instrument: 68% light, 64% dark, as a solid mix

tokens.name: hue.use
tokens.rule: status only: needs you, done, failed; never selection, hover, outline, link or focus

tokens.name: contrast.text-floor
tokens.rule: 4.5:1 for every text run, on the worst pixel it can sit on, on the worse of the two tones

tokens.name: contrast.mark-floor
tokens.drawnOn: icons, status marks, control outlines that carry meaning

tokens.name: tone.seam
tokens.rule: 0: no sliver of one tone past the line between the two

tokens.name: selection.row
tokens.drawnOn: selected sidebar row, selected list row (ink.selected on the frame: 1.18:1 light, 1.26:1 dark)

tokens.name: selection.tab
tokens.drawnOn: selected tab, joined to its pane

tokens.name: glass.where
tokens.rule: native chrome and native floating surfaces; never under prose
tokens.drawnOn: title bar, sidebar, menus and popovers the system draws

tokens.name: prose.measure
tokens.drawnOn: chat prose column (600 in the look)

tokens.name: prose.line-height
tokens.drawnOn: chat prose, composer (20 px on 14; the RFD's prose.size 14 / 20)

tokens.name: tool-row.size
tokens.drawnOn: tool rows, "Worked for" (no-token: the app draws them at a fixed size)

tokens.name: code.inline-break
tokens.rule: never: inline code does not break mid-token

tokens.name: join.curve
tokens.drawnOn: selected tab to pane (waits on a Mac capture; no-token: cornerFlush has no curve)

tokens.name: type.weights
tokens.drawnOn: all text (700 draws monogram initials today)
